summary: Practise emergency health assessment, IPC checks, hygiene planning and referral mapping. Explore the five-day foundation course and its field-ready outputs.
lede: Humanitarian emergency health and hygiene training helps frontline teams assess risks and plan responses. It is for frontline health staff, hygiene promoters and response coordinators who need to map service gaps and referrals, use infection prevention checklists, and plan inclusive hygiene messages and outbreak-alert workflows. Exercises produce practical assessment and action-planning records, while surveillance systems and coordination receive foundation-level coverage.
audienceIntro: This foundation course is designed for professionals who work directly with emergency health services, community hygiene activities or the coordination systems that connect them. It suits people who need practical tools for field assessment, safer care and referral planning.
audience: Infection Prevention and Control Focal Points
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with humanitarian response roles is useful. No clinical qualification or programming experience is required.
